title: Victory Over Temptation
description: A lesson on understanding temptation and how believers can overcome it through Christ.

cards.heading: The Truth About Temptation
cards.scriptureText: God cannot be tempted by evil, nor does he tempt anyone.
cards.body: Temptation does not come from God. While He may allow trials, the source of temptation is our sinful desires and external enticements.
cards.question: How do you usually distinguish between testing and temptation?

cards.heading: The Source of Temptation
cards.scriptureText: Each person is tempted when they are dragged away by their own evil desire.
cards.body: Temptation begins from sinful desires within and may be strengthened by Satan’s external influence.
cards.question: What temptations most often challenge you?

cards.heading: The Process of Falling
cards.scriptureText: David got up from his bed and walked around on the roof.
cards.body: Temptation often begins with idleness, attention, continued focus, and finally sinful action. David’s fall with Bathsheba is a clear example.
cards.question: What early warning signs do you notice before falling into temptation?

cards.heading: Hold Fast to God’s Word
cards.scriptureText: I have hidden your word in my heart that I might not sin against you.
cards.body: The Word of God is one of the most powerful weapons against temptation.
cards.question: What Scripture helps you fight temptation?

cards.heading: Be a Doer of the Word
cards.scriptureText: Do not merely listen to the word, and so deceive yourselves. Do what it says.
cards.body: Victory comes not only from knowing God’s Word but from obeying it daily.
cards.question: How can you apply what you already know from Scripture?

cards.heading: Submit to God and Resist the Devil
cards.scriptureText: Submit yourselves, then, to God. Resist the devil, and he will flee from you.
cards.body: Believers overcome temptation by fully submitting to God and actively resisting Satan’s influence.
cards.question: What practical steps help you resist temptation?

cards.heading: Application: Victory Through Christ
cards.scriptureText: The one who is in you is greater than the one who is in the world.
cards.body: No Christian needs to live defeated by sin. Victory is possible through the strength and help of Christ.
cards.question: What area of temptation do you need Christ’s strength for today?
